strings.en: Master Hazuki... A transmission from Ichiro Hibiki of the Mutron Laboratory.
Put him through, please.
Ah, Commander Hazuki, thank you for the other day.
We've analyzed the tablet found in those Mutron ruins...
and learned a great deal, so I thought I should let you know.
I see... And what did you learn?
Information on Mutron, of course, but...
it also contained records of the Einst.
It would be best to speak in person.
...By the way, how is the Gran Garan for supplies?
...With the Cyber Beast Force base in that state... frankly, it's hard.
I thought so... Won't you let us prepare supplies for you?
Though you would need to come to Mutropolis once...
That's much appreciated. Queen Sheela, is that all right with you?
By all means, we would be grateful...
No, please, there's no need to be so formal.
It's the least I can do for saving my life and my wife's.
Thank you for your kindness... Dr. Hibiki. We'll see you shortly.
We'll be waiting.
So... the Star of La Mu has fallen into those humans' hands at last... Grrr...
Lord Barao... what will you do now...!?
Calm yourself, Gorai. ...We are out of time... There is only one way...!
D-Don't tell me... Lord Barao, this... Demon Island!?
Yes, I shall make bloody sacrifices of them myself...!
You understand your role... do you not?
I understand. ...Raideen is the foe who killed my brother Gekido...!
I will defeat it without fail...!
I understand.
...I will take back the Star of La Mu without fail!
Accursed Raideen...! Next time for certain...!
(Twelve thousand years ago... I was caught off guard then,
but this time they show no sign of stirring... I cannot fail again...!)
Now then, we'd like to hear about Mutron.
Of course. But before that, there's something I must tell Akira.
The reason your mother... Reiko disappeared
was to search for a certain object while hiding from Barao.
...And what that object is... you know as well, don't you?
The Star of La Mu...
...This tablet was found in the ruins where the Star of La Mu lay.
Weird hieroglyphs... I've never seen anything like 'em.
Yes... It almost looks like a little mosaic.
It says La Mu, king of the ancient Mu Empire, just before its fall...
in preparation for the coming revival of Demon Emperor Barao,
left behind three things.
...One of them is the Star of La Mu.
And what are the other two?
...The brave Raideen, which Akira pilots, and my wife Reiko...
or rather, Lemuria, by her name in the ancient Mu Empire.
Mom!?
Wowee! So Reiko's from twelve thousand years ago?
...Yes.
Whoa, so you're twelve thousand years old?
Koji! It's rude to ask a woman about her age!
Besides, it must have been cryosleep or something like that!
Twelve thousand years of cold sleep... Can anyone survive that?
True, after cryosleep for that long...
I can't imagine someone waking up unharmed...
Lemuria, of the ancient Mu bloodline... like our son Akira,
has psychokinesis.
Mom has psychokinesis too!?
I protected my body with that psychokinesis and slept in cryosleep
until the present day...
You said earlier there was something written about the Einst...
Yes, this tablet also contains records about the Einst...
In other words, twelve thousand years ago, in the Mu Empire's age,
the Einst series had already appeared...
What!? They were showing up way back then...?
It says the Einst series fought both the Demon Empire and the Mu Empire.
Fought both? A three-way war with the Demon and Mu Empires...?
According to the tablet, yes.
We can guess the Einst may have been after the Star of La Mu,
but the truth is unknown...
What kind of power does the Star of La Mu hold?
The Star of La Mu is merely a means to unleash Mutron energy.
And what happens if that Mutron energy is unleashed?
It's said to grant power that could destroy the Demon Empire instantly.
Didn't Rom's home, planet Cronos, have something similar...?
The Hyper Libido.
From what Rom and the others told us, the Hyper Libido could even
shift a planet's axis...
Amazing...!
To think something like that existed here on Earth...
Then why don't we just hurry up and use this Star of La Mu thing?
The tablet also says this... When the Star of La Mu is activated,
Lemuria will face grave danger...
You mean...
Akira's mom's life would be on the line?
Grave danger... most likely, that is what it means...
Oh no...
If my life can destroy the Demon Empire,
I will gladly offer it up to the god of La Mu...
M-Mom...
Don't worry, Akira.
If we take out the Demon Empire with our own hands, there's no problem.
Koji's right. Those who can fight must fight.
But... there are more than a few who'd seize the Star of La Mu
and try to use its power.
Maybe it'd be better if we held on to the Star of La Mu
ourselves.
I see. So we would lure the enemy to us ourselves.
Hmm... If the Star of La Mu stays in Mutropolis, it'll always be a target.
If we've got the Star of La Mu, the enemy'll come right to us,
so that works out fine, doesn't it?
I'd rather they didn't come too often, though.
We're on guard, but Mutropolis's defenses can only do so much.
What do you think? Perhaps we could
take custody of the Star of La Mu...?
Indeed... Leaving it with you would be safest.
But, dear...
Leave it to us. As long as it's in our hands,
we won't let anyone else lay a finger on it!
What's going on!?
Enemy attack! And it's...!
Wh-What is that!?
Dear... I'm certain. That is Demon Emperor Barao's base... Demon Island!
That's Barao's island!?
What a... sinister aura it gives off...
Commander Hazuki...!
I know... It seems the enemy is serious...!
The Gran is ready to launch.
The Goraon is ready as well, Lady Elle.
Commander Hazuki!
Yes. All right, recall everyone and take battle stations at once!
We will intercept Demon Emperor Barao...!
